description: This file contains unit tests for the Ascii85 encoding and decoding functionality in the PDFsharp library, specifically tests related to the Ascii85Decode class. It uses Xunit for testing and includes tests for Wikipedia examples, empty data, no-padding and padding cases, and literal data handling.

classes.name: Ascii85Tests
classes.description: A class containing unit tests for Ascii85 encoding/decoding functionalities.

methods.name: Check_Wikipedia_example
methods.description: Verifies that the Ascii85 decoding and encoding match the Wikipedia example, ensuring no endianness issues.

methods.name: Check_empty_data
methods.description: Tests encoding and decoding of empty data arrays.

methods.name: Check_no_padding
methods.description: Checks encoding and decoding of data without padding, covering a range of values.

methods.name: Check_padding
methods.description: Tests encoding and decoding with padding for 1, 2, and 3-byte input data, including performance on large ranges.

methods.name: Check_literal_data
methods.description: Tests encoding and decoding with specific literal data arrays, including verification via string conversion.
